sentences: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming, with the likes of Disney +, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was.

But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $ 2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.
translations: 自从老牌好莱坞与Netflix公司正面竞争以来，一直在流媒体领域难以盈利，迪士尼+、孔雀和派拉蒙+等平台每年亏损数十亿美元，引发了人们对这些服务永远不会像有线电视曾经那样盈利的担忧。
但流媒体时代对一些意想不到的赢家来说却是一笔财富：那些使用软件在几秒钟内从合法在线视频平台盗录电影或电视节目，并将这些内容托管在自己非法服务上的盗版者，他们每年通过广告和订阅赚取约20亿美元。

sentences: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that's working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
translations: 根据电影协会（MPA）的数据，由于没有视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近90%。电影协会是一个代表好莱坞制片厂的行业组织，致力于打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。

sentences: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.

But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $ 30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce's Global Innovation Policy Center.
The global impact is about $ 71 billion annually.
translations: 最初，像Netflix这样的合法在线业务的兴起实际上帮助遏制了数字盗版，这种盗版主要基于文件上传。
但美国商会全球创新政策中心估计，现在涉及非法流媒体服务和文件共享的盗版每年给美国经济造成约300亿美元的收入损失和约25万个工作岗位的损失。
全球影响每年约为710亿美元。

sentences: "The people who are stealing our movies and our television shows and operating piracy sites are not mom and pop operations," says Charlie Rivkin, chief executive officer of the MPA.

Rivkin joined the MPA in 2017 after the organization failed five years earlier to build consensus between Hollywood and Silicon Valley to win passage of legislation in Congress aimed at stopping online piracy.

In 2017 the association formed the Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment (ACE), an enforcement task force of about 100 detectives circling the globe to help local authorities arrest streaming pirates.
translations: “那些窃取我们电影和电视节目并运营盗版网站的人不是夫妻店式的经营，”MPA首席执行官查理·里夫金说。
里夫金于2017年加入MPA，此前该组织在五年前未能促成好莱坞和硅谷之间达成共识，以推动国会通过旨在阻止在线盗版的立法。
2017年，该协会成立了创意与娱乐联盟（ACE），这是一个由约100名侦探组成的执法工作组，在全球范围内协助当地政府逮捕流媒体盗版者。

sentences: ACE says it's helped shrink the number of illegal streaming services in North America to 126, from more than 1,400 in 2018, aided in part by the MPA's support for a 2020 federal law that made large-scale streaming of copyrighted material a serious crime.
translations: ACE表示，它已帮助将北美的非法流媒体服务数量从2018年的1400多个减少到126个，部分得益于MPA对2020年联邦法律的支持，该法律将大规模流式传播受版权保护的内容定为严重犯罪。

sentences: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services' cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $ 113 billion in the next two years.

"While there is some optimism that emerging countermeasures and best practices may see piracy begin to plateau by 2027, there is no consensus among stakeholders as to when it may begin to decline," says analyst Steve Hawley.
translations: 咨询公司Parks Associates预测，自2022年以来，美国合法流媒体服务因盗版造成的累计损失将在未来两年内达到1130亿美元。
“尽管有人乐观地认为，新兴的对策和最佳实践可能会使盗版在2027年前开始趋于平稳，但利益相关者之间对于何时可能开始下降尚未达成共识，”分析师史蒂夫·霍利说。

sentences:
31. According to Paragraph 1, legitimate streaming services
A. have drawn lessons from Hollywood
B. have surpassed cable in revenue
C. are unpopular with advertisers
D. are confronted with a real threat
translations:
31. 根据第一段，合法的流媒体服务
A. 从好莱坞吸取了教训
B. 在收入上超过了有线电视
C. 不受广告商的欢迎
D. 面临着真正的威胁

sentences:
32. It can be learned that streamers like Netflix
A. played a part in the fight against illegal file-sharing
B. reaped benefits from the war with digital pirates
C. promised to become big job creators in the US
D. used to collaborate with file-uploading platforms
translations:
32. 可以了解到，像Netflix这样的流媒体服务商
A. 在打击非法文件共享方面发挥了作用
B. 从与数字盗版的战争中获益
C. 承诺成为美国的大型就业创造者
D. 过去曾与文件上传平台合作

sentences:
33. It can be inferred from Paragraph 4 that the MPA
A. was denied cooperation by Silicon Valley
B. led a national protest against online piracy
C. was urged to form an enforcement task force
D. failed to win support from local authorities
translations:
33. 从第四段可以推断出，MPA
A. 被硅谷拒绝合作
B. 领导了一场反对在线盗版的全国性抗议
C. 被敦促成立执法工作组
D. 未能赢得地方政府的支持

sentences:
34. According to Hawley, digital piracy
A. cannot be checked in spite of new legislation
B. will possibly overwhelm legitimate streamers
C. is unlikely to diminish in the near future
D. has been underestimated by some analysts
translations:
34. 根据霍利的说法，数字盗版
A. 尽管有新的立法，但无法被遏制
B. 可能会压垮合法的流媒体服务商
C. 在不久的将来不太可能减少
D. 被一些分析师低估了

sentences:
35. Which of the following is emphasized in the text?
A. The need to coordinate anti-piracy action.
B. The criminal nature of copyright violation.
C. The prospect of eliminating online piracy.
D. The economic harm from illegal streaming.
translations:
35. 以下哪项在文中被强调？
A. 协调反盗版行动的必要性。
B. 侵犯版权的犯罪性质。
C. 消除在线盗版的前景。
D. 非法流媒体造成的经济损失。
